title: Front door restructure: landing-page README, docs/architecture.md, docs/evidence.md
goal: README.md becomes a landing page of about 150 lines (what Susi is, who it is for, a two-minute start, the host contract and its port-collision note, the honest delivery state with links). The architecture material moves to docs/architecture.md with content preserved and the Wasm runtime stated correctly everywhere (Wasmi inside the compatibility-named susi-vendor-wasmtime crate serves both Tier-0 reflexes and the crown sandbox probes; no Wasmtime is linked). The verified-claims and platform/qualification material moves verbatim to docs/evidence.md with every admitted gap kept. ARCHITECTURE.md keeps the enforceable contract, fixes its Wasm statements and points at the new document. Every sentence passes tests/core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins.rs and the README needles in tests/architecture_tests.rs.
